overview: The plans separate apartment area from balcony area. Compare the enclosed accommodation and actual orientation before treating a published total as usable indoor space.
research.locationNote: Downtown Jebel Ali, Dubai, near JAFZA, Sheikh Zayed Road and Life Pharmacy Metro. Confirm the selected apartment’s actual access route.
research.priceNote: Property Finder retains AED 555,000 as a launch reference and marks its displayed developer configurations out of stock. This does not establish the lowest currently bookable unit, resale price or availability; obtain a dated offer.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder publishes 10% on booking, 40% during construction and 50% on handover. GCC Offplan separately describes four 10% instalments at 30, 180, 330 and 480 days after the down payment. Those third-party terms are not a verified current developer calendar; fees and reservation conditions require written confirmation.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder lists March 2028/Q1 2028, while the older GCC Offplan record says December 2027. No later primary completion notice or contractual reconciliation was retrieved. The date remains unconfirmed; rendered imagery is not construction evidence.
